# adds_gpo (Data Source)

Reads an existing Group Policy Object. Use it to reference a GPO that this Terraform configuration did not create, for example to link it (`adds_gpo_links`), set its permissions (`adds_gpo_permission`), or attach a security or WMI filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing Group Policy Object by display name (a GUID works too), for example
# one created in GPMC, and attach policy plumbing to it without importing it.
data "adds_gpo" "baseline" {
  identity = "Corp - Workstation Baseline"
}

resource "adds_gpo_links" "baseline_on_workstations" {
  target = "Contoso/Workstations"

  links = [
    { gpo = data.adds_gpo.baseline.guid },
  ]
}

output "baseline_gpo" {
  value = {
    guid               = data.adds_gpo.baseline.guid
    distinguished_name = data.adds_gpo.baseline.distinguished_name
    status             = data.adds_gpo.baseline.status
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the GPO to look up. Accepts the GPO display name or its GUID. Reading fails if no GPO matches.

### Read-Only

- `computer_ad_version` (Number) Computer configuration version in the directory.
- `computer_sysvol_version` (Number) Computer configuration version in SYSVOL.
- `creation_time` (String) Creation timestamp, in round-trip (`o`) format.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `distinguished_name` (String) Distinguished name of the GPO object under `CN=Policies,CN=System`.
- `domain` (String) DNS name of the domain the GPO belongs to.
- `guid` (String) GPO GUID.
- `id` (String) GPO GUID.
- `modification_time` (String) Last modification timestamp, in round-trip (`o`) format.
- `name` (String) Display name of the GPO.
- `status` (String) GPO status, for example `AllSettingsEnabled` or `AllSettingsDisabled`.
- `user_ad_version` (Number) User configuration version in the directory.
- `user_sysvol_version` (Number) User configuration version in SYSVOL.
